slides.title: Why you can clean a friend's house in an hour but not your own
It's called body doubling
slides.body: Having another person around, even doing nothing, makes it easier for many of us to start and keep going.

slides.title: No friend around? Go virtual
slides.body: Search 'clean with me' videos or body doubling livestreams. Someone else cleaning on screen works surprisingly well.

slides.title: FaceTime a friend, both clean
slides.body: Prop your phone up, clean your own spaces, chat or don't. 20 minutes, then hang up. Swap weekly.

slides.title: Trade houses
slides.body: Clean together at hers one week, yours the next. Other people's mess is easier to face than our own.

slides.title: Narrate to your pet
slides.body: Sounds silly. Talking out loud about what you're doing keeps our brain on the task. The dog doesn't judge.

slides.title: I don't need motivation. I need someone else in the room.
Pair body doubling with a plan
slides.body: The Messy Brain Home Reset gives your cleaning sessions a clear 7-day plan to follow. Link in bio.
